reasoning: The claim that generative AI "will replace 300 million jobs" is misleading because it misrepresents the findings of the widely cited Goldman Sachs research report (March 2023) from which this figure originates. The Goldman Sachs report estimated that generative AI could expose the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs globally to "automation," meaning that some portion of their workload could be automated. The authors specifically noted that most jobs and industries are only partially exposed to automation and are far more likely to be complemented by AI rather than fully replaced. Furthermore, historical trends suggest that automation-driven job displacement is typically offset by the creation of new employment opportunities and increased productivity.
